reviews.title: Too many ads, too much money
reviews.text: This is the most expensive streaming platform I’ve seen.  HBO, Netflix, Hulu, prime are all much less and Philos shows are full of 2 1/2 minute commercials for 28.99 a month. Ridiculous.  When I subscribed I located the show and season I wanted but for that specific season I would have had to upgrade to their $39 plan. Thats more than double the more common streaming platforms. In a 2 hour show I experienced 12 of those 2 1/2 minute commercials. I immediately canceled before the one week trial ended.  Spend a lot less money elsewhere like I did

reviews.title: Worst Streaming Service Availible
reviews.text: I’m sick to my stomach that I didn’t cancel this horrible, expensive, and unnavigable streaming service before my free trial ended. I’ve never had a free trial that has given me the certainty that a service was not worth it prior to falling for Philo’s 7-day free trial. The amount of ads which assail you, even (and especially) on on-demand viewings, is inexcusable, especially for a service which starts at $25 a month ($300/year). Use literally any other streaming service or cable provider - I can’t think of one I’d prefer to use less than Philo. There is not one feature which comes to mind that would justify Philo’s existence, or its price-tag, and I would leave 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: There is a reason Philo still does Free Trials
reviews.text:
Paying $25 just for the Essential Pack is crazy. Then, after buying the pack and getting on the streaming service, I saw that most of the movies and TV shows were old. Honestly, it felt like the biggest waste of money.

I would not recommend Philo unless you are someone who enjoys really old movies and TV shows. If that’s your preference, then it may work for you, but if not, this is not the right streaming service. They are not even updated on TV shows that came out in 2021, and they don’t have all the episodes uploaded.

Overall, I highly would not recommend Philo.
